## 2026-10-16 — baseline (season day 1)

**Official**
- Season SS14 Tartarus (塔罗斯的困兽) live: Oct 15 19:00 PDT = Oct 16 10:00 GMT+8.
- Patch notes include a 10/14 supplemental log that overrides the main text (followers: Lone Wolf buff; Focused Strike 4→6 stacks; Full Suppression +50%→+20%; Youga 3 Core auto-summon 10 m/0.1 s; Realm Beyond Reach drops globally in Profound+).
- Tartarus no longer drops Nether King's Broken Divinity; Nether King's Divinity drops much more often and can be traded.

**Measured live (community, compiled in the simulator)**
- Rarity odds behind a door: 40/38/12/8/2 (N/M/R/L/S), n=1,011 doors. *Before the measurement the simulator used 52/27/15/6/0.*
- Replace odds: 52/32/9/6/1.5, n=261.
- Second meal from Legendary up (Mammoth also eats Wolf; Lion also eats Rat): seen 3× live.
- "Cancel" stops a consumption chain after any bite.
- The game gives **1** instrument choice at the start (not 3 picks).
- Objectives seen: King of the Caged, Prison Walk (18 tiles), Survival of the Fittest (consume 4×), Undercurrents (2 incidents).
- Pre-run cards seen: Cage Fight, Iron Law (30 days), Tyranny.

**Simulator**: version `20261016zzc` (snapshot in `data/snapshots/sim_20261016zzc.json`).
- Optimal strategy: 3.43 Rainbows/run with rewards; 0.98 without instruments.
- Best solo instrument: Iron Crown (2.71). Best pair: Hangman's Noose + Severed Iron Maiden (15.45).

## 2026-10-16 (night) — live telemetry incorporated

Source: `rates.json` from the simulator repo (https://github.com/blahdot3h/tartarus-simulator, `beta/data/rates.json`) — 38,011 boards, 5,873 runs shared by players via the board analyzer. Now pulled by `scripts/update_data.py`.

- Door (n=7,191): Normal 41.8% · Magic 35.9% · Rare 11.4% · Legendary 9.2% · Supreme 1.8% (the 1,011 sample gave 40/38/12/8/2).
- Beast behind the door: Mammoth 24.1% · Lion 23.2% · Wolf 26.3% · Rat 26.4% (slightly off 25%, p≈0.00007).
- Replace (n=696): Normal 42.2% · Magic 33.3% · Rare 14.5% · Legendary 7.3% · Supreme 2.3% · **Rainbow 0.3%** (2 seen). *Corrects the 261 sample (52/32/9/6/1.5): Replace is nearly the same as a door, not worse.*
- Mornings with only 2 doors: **16.9%** (n=8,592); the simulator assumed 0%.
- Doors with an event on day 1: **6.4%** (n=10,370); the simulator assumed 5%.
- Lost Ring of Keys opens neighbors in **62.8%** (n=199), not 80%. Side doors opened without the Ring 157× in 6,944.
- Consumption: 1.12 bites per devour (n=155); the beast changed after a bite 73% of the time (matches a uniform re-roll = 75%).
- **Instrument offers (n=110 offers): Iron Crown and Elephant-Foot Maul 0×; Skewer, Tongs, Guillotine 2×; Iron Box 4×.** Beast-specific instruments are rare → Crown is the best solo but almost never shows up. Most offered: Scapegoat 19, Pestle 19, Hook 18, Keys 18, Stake 16.
- Actual Rainbows per run (114 runs with a full readout, the agent's calculation over the raw jsonl): **mean 2.04, median 2**, 25% with 0, max 8. Below the sim's 3.43 (biased sample, early league).

**Community (Oct 16–17)**
- Possible **cap of 10 Rainbows per run** (a comment + many "10彩" titles on Bilibili) — not confirmed.
- **Meat Grinder mode**: consumes 3× the nameplates, +50% drops (read on stream by DonTheCrown).
- Riot: 3 levels (上层/中层/下层), up to ~9 prisoners per level, **6 attempts** ("剩余挑战次数 6/6").
- The mechanic only appears 100% of the time on maps from **TM7** onward; relevant profit from TM7 onward (dev in an interview). K7 drops stacks of 1 FE; K8 stacks of 1/5/10/20.
- Anecdotal profit: ~1 FE per Rainbow in K7; ~20 FE/run (CoffeeBns, 7-2); 12–20 FE/run (Don).
- Twin Inquisitors C6 ≈ +40–48% loot — weaker than previous seasonal pets (Don live; pre-launch Reddit calculation).
- 吉吉罗's CN simulator stopped being updated on Oct 14; the EN one (CoffeeBns) keeps updating with live data.

## 2026-10-16 (night) — image analysis (`images/INDEX.md`, `images/mechanic_data.json`)

38 images verified and transcribed (official preview VOD in 1080p, press kit, official site, live screenshots from Bilibili/Reddit).

- **Run entry:** a live screenshot shows "1/12" on "Start Warden's Duty" and "1/48" in the inventory → **12 nameplates per run** (inferred from the UI; no explicit text).
- **Riot:** in 5 screens (VOD + 4 live), prisoners are sorted by descending rarity and distributed round-robin Upper → Middle → Lower.
- **10-Rainbow cap reinforced:** the 4 live runs with a riot screen have exactly 10 Chromatic; the containment panel has ~10 slots (visual count). Could still be bias in who posts.
- **Open conflict — second meal:** pre-launch images (01, 02) show Mammoth→Wolf and Lion→Rat already at Normal/Magic; the simulator says that live it only applies from Legendary+ (3 observations). The map stays at Legendary+; no live screenshot settles it yet.
- Full in-game beast names: Mammoth, **Berserk** Lion, **Alpha** Wolf, **Colossal** Rat. Rarity 5 appears as "Ultimate" (至臻) in the UI.
